items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: John McMurray probably used that, didn't they?

ctx.x: Well, it's made like a banjo. Yeah. You know, it's a single head with no bottom. Where would the snares be? The snares would be right up on the top. Oh, underneath the...

Well, I'd say you turned an ordinary snare drum up and was beating on the snare head. Yeah, that's right, that's right, that's right. Oh, yeah, I get you. Of course, a lot of the fellas would use that. John McMurray probably used that, didn't they?
